notes:
Inbound SMB self-serve lead. Using Redwood hosted API on public cloud; primary pain is perceived latency for chat web widget. Key facts: early-stage product team, cost sensitive, prefers minimal ops (no dedicated).

Observed behavior from logs and customer tests: short messages (system + prompt ~250-450 tokens) producing end-to-end latency median ~600ms in us-east-1; p95 spikes to ~1.1s; cold-starts up to ~2s. Customer target: interactive feel, ideally <300-400ms for short turnarounds.

SE guidance already given (see checklist):
- Region choice: route traffic to nearest region; for NA production recommend us-west-2 or us-east-1 depending on user base. In our tests us-west-2 reduced median by ~200-300ms for this customer's infra.
- SDK/HTTP settings: set client keep-alive, reduce connection churn, increase HTTP pool size, enable streaming to surface tokens earlier. Default client timeout set to 30s — recommend lowering application-level request timeout to 10-20s for UI flows and set per-request max_tokens to limit tail latency.
- Prompt hygiene: trim system prompts, avoid sending full product catalogs in request body; move static context into server-side cached embeddings or use prefix KV cache where possible. Target prompt sizes <400 tokens for snappy responses.
- Model/response config: use smaller-faster verified models for chat baseline (low-cost variant) and fallback to higher-quality models async for long responses. Tune temperature and max_tokens to reduce token generation time.
- Retries/backoff: exponential backoff with jitter; avoid aggressive client-side retries that multiply load.
- Instrumentation: enable token-level timing in Console, collect p50/p95/p99 by route and region; share traces with SE for deeper analysis.

Customer constraints & concerns: limited engineering bandwidth to implement all SDK tweaks immediately; a few EU customers require clarification on residency (may need private or region pinning). Price sensitivity — prefers hosted plan not Dedicated.

Next actions agreed: short perf POC in us-west-2 (Riley to coordinate), Samir to provide a condensed perf tuning checklist and example SDK patch for Node/Python to change keep-alive and timeout settings, customer to run tests and share results by 2026-03-19.
